title: Belfast St Patrick's Whitley Memorial
location_name: St Patrick's Church, Belfast, County Antrim
memorial_details: Wooden prayer desk to Sgt T.W.A. Crone (Wireless Operator), KIA 17 May 1941, inside St Patrick's Church, Belfast.
narrative: Whitley Z6578 of 77 Squadron, coded KN-P, departed Topcliffe at 2230 on 16 May 1941 bound for Cologne. The aircraft was coned by searchlights and shot down at 0234 on 17 May by Leutnant Kurt Loos of II/NJG1, his first claim. The aircraft crashed near Rothem, approximately 6km SSW of Maaseik in Belgium. Three crew were killed; two became prisoners of war.
cause_of_loss: Shot down by night fighter — Lt Kurt Loos (II/NJG1), his 1st claim
